long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.makes: a labnote on the moon's colour
steps.reason: It is dusk and the telescope is mine, so I will look at the moon's colour through it before anyone else does.
The moon has been looked at enough for one evening, so I will run it off across the island.

today.reason: The bowl is empty until morning and it is dusk, so the only things I can do now are the telescope and zoomies.
